author: pricey108
body:
Hello everyone Pricey108 here.

I have just released my new nexus map that i have been working on for sometime now.
It is called Muthis.

YAML coming soon.

You can find images here: http://imgur.com/a/5qLNO#12
You can download my map here: https://www.dropbox.com/s/dtuf3o8ofwt7rkn/Muthis.zip?dl=0
Hope it gets accepted and please map dev's dont forget this one like the last one i had made called Capraz.
I am now going to work on a TDM map so i might be away for a while.

HOPE YOU ENJOY.

Features.
Team coloured beacons for 1.8
Tunnels
Two stories
Archer Towers
hard to get to spawn
decoration plants.
